logp.method_description: LogP values of complexes 2-4 were determined from logarithmic ratio of distribution coefficient of complexes in an n-octanol and water biphasic mixture. Stock solutions of 2-4 were made in DMSO with a final concentration of 5mM. 6 µL aliquot from this stock solution was taken and the final volume was made to 500 µL. The octanol-water mixture with a final volume of 500 µL (1:1, v/v) was mixed for 1h at 37 °C using rotor rotating 70 rpm. The aqueous layer was carefully separated from the octanol layer. 75 µL of aqueous layer was digested with 300 µL nitric acid for 3 days at room temperature followed by 4 h at 60°C and the final volume was made to 5 ml using DI water. Similarly, 50 µL of octanol was taken and digested with 300 µL nitric acid for 3 days at room temperature followed by 4 h at 60°C. The final volume of the digested octanol layer was also made to 5 ml using DI water. The metal concentrations in both layers were measured using ICP-MS. The partition coefficients of metal complexes were calculated using the equation LogP = Log ([M] octanol /[M] water).
